description:
Convert a 5-slide thesis presentation into a single-slide large-format academic poster (30" x 20").

Starting with the loaded presentation 'thesis_draft.odp':
1. Change the slide dimensions to Width: 30 inches, Height: 20 inches (Landscape).
2. Copy the text content from Slides 2, 3, 4, and 5 and paste it all onto Slide 1, arranging it so it is visible.
3. Delete slides 2, 3, 4, and 5 so only the single poster slide remains.
4. Save the file as 'research_poster.odp' in the '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/' directory.
